title: MR Strategy — FCF Top-200, 10 Most Oversold
description: Mean Reversion backtest results. Universe: top-1500 domestic, FCF>2%, net debt <=1x, vol >=. Stage-1: top-200 by FCF yield. Stage-2: 10 most oversold. Daily rebalance. IS 2001-2021: CAGR +28.5%, IR 0.724, MaxDD -75.1%. OOS 2022-2026: CAGR +12.9%, IR 0.370, MaxDD -37.6%. Now includes signal_70d_return (the actual stage-2 oversold-ranking signal) as its own column, alongside fcf_yield (stage-1 ranking signal) - previously only fcf_yield was output since our CSV logic only auto-included the primary strategy signal, not the secondary-sort signal actually used to pick the 10 stocks.

title: MOM Strategy — Our Mani-Spec Reproduction (OOS 2022-2026)

Shown here: OOS 2022-2026 holdings and daily returns. Our OOS CAGR +45.0%, OOS MaxDD -40.8% (near-exact match) vs. Mani's published OOS CAGR +42.4%, OOS MaxDD -40.78%. Compare directly against Mani's mom_500_fcf0_final_pit_2026-07-02.csv above.

title: LV Strategy — Our Mani-Spec Reproduction (OOS 2022-2026)

Our OOS CAGR +13.7%, IS CAGR +11.6% / IS MaxDD -34.4% (computed separately) vs. Mani's published OOS CAGR +10.4%, IS CAGR +11.90% / IS MaxDD -31.52%. Compare directly against Mani's lv_600_fcf5_final_pit_2026-07-02.csv above.

title: MR Strategy — Our Mani-Spec Reproduction (OOS 2022-2026)
description: Our reproduction of Mani's disclosed MR spec (N=1500, Stage-1 top-200 FCF yield, Stage-2 10 most oversold on 70d return, FCF>=2%, net debt<=1x, $20M DV floor, min_price>=$2 entry / $0.50 exit, daily rebalance), run against our master_prices_computed after this week's full reconciliation fix set (ASOF join direction, revenue sticky-pass, hard-exit screens, dual-class per-date tie-break, min_exit_price). Compare directly against Mani's mr_fcf200_mr10_vol20_final_pit_2026-07-02.csv above.

title: MOM Strategy — Top-500 Domestic, FCF>0%
description: Momentum (6m1m) backtest results. Universe: top-500 domestic stocks by market cap, positive FCF. Weekly Friday rebalance (drift-hold between rebals), N=10. IS 2001-2021: CAGR +15.4%, IR 0.558, MaxDD -59.6%. OOS 2022-2026: CAGR +42.4%, IR 1.085, MaxDD -40.8%. Point-in-time corrected: fundamentals now visible only strictly after the filing date, and the revenue screen uses a cumulative as-of-date check.

title: LV Strategy — Top-600 Domestic, FCF>5%
description: Low Volatility backtest results. Universe: top-600 domestic stocks by market cap, FCF yield >5%. Weekly Friday rebalance (drift-hold between rebals), N=10, 60d vol signal. IS 2001-2021: CAGR +11.9%, IR 0.952, MaxDD -31.5%. OOS 2022-2026: CAGR +10.4%, IR 0.877, MaxDD -12.5%. Point-in-time corrected: fundamentals now visible only strictly after the filing date (no same-day look-ahead), and the revenue screen uses a cumulative as-of-date check (crossed the growing bar at some point in the past, using the threshold that applied then) rather than a whole-period future-peeking check.
